title: Memorial Union Student Center Program Plan

truth_boundary.note: Memorial Union is the requested student-center role and working name. Until public references and a reviewed blueprint exist, every room, route, dimension, facade, and adjacency below is an original planning proposal rather than a reconstruction claim.

spaces: fireplace-style gathering lounge without copying a real private layout
divisible multipurpose ballroom or event hall
student-organization offices and shared project room

building_operations: custodial closets on each public level
public_health_access_and_safety: elevator and protected stairs if more than one level is approved
fire separation and kitchen exhaust review
clear emergency access and assembly point

proposed_adjacency_rules: arrival lobby connects visibly to information, food hall, main lounge, and a vertical-circulation decision point
college store is visible from the main public path but has a secure stock route separate from customer flow
food venues share a screened service spine to receiving, storage, prep, dishwashing, and waste without crossing the main public route
quiet study and commuter lounges are acoustically buffered from the food hall and event hall
event hall has pre-function space, nearby restrooms, controlled after-hours access, storage, loading access, and an independent egress review
student-organization and meeting rooms remain findable from the public circulation spine without exposing operational back-of-house areas
first_review_route: food hall threshold and one representative generic venue
return to campus path toward the library entrance

inferred: A believable student center needs public gathering, food, retail, meeting, event, student-service, and operational support functions.
Public and back-of-house circulation should separate where food handling, loading, waste, stock, and event operations require it.
unknown: floor count, footprint, dimensions, and structural grid
code-required exits, fire separations, kitchen exhaust, plumbing counts, and accessibility details
materials, signage, furniture, acoustics, lighting, and landscape
all final adjacencies and service routes

resource_and_build_policy.future_preview_requirement: fresh isolated resource gate followed by one deliberately bounded route slice
